rules.statement: Where the same property is seized and sold under two writs and neither seizure is registered, the purchaser under the writ upon which the property was first sold is entitled to priority by reason of the retroactive effect given to his Fiscal's conveyance under section 289 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: 'Where the same property is seized and sold under two writs and neither seizure is registered, the purchaser under the writ upon which the property was first sold is entitled to priority by reason of the retroactive effect given to his Fiscal's conveyance under the provisions of section 289 of the Civil Procedure Code.'
